name: 冷気
design: 霜をまとった氷の格闘兵。白髪、青い肌、紺の防寒服、氷の拳と肩結晶。
prompt: Ice-element martial adventurer, silver-blue layered hair, calm narrow blue eyes, deep blue fitted fantasy tunic with silver frost embroidery, white scarf, leather belt, pale ice gauntlets, dark blue boots

name: 重撃
design: 鉄灰と暗赤の処刑人。重い肩当て、鉄仮面、既存の鉄斧。
prompt: Heavy axe knight, steel-gray armor over burgundy quilted tunic, iron forehead guard leaving stern anime eyes and lower face visible, black hair, red sash, plate greaves

name: 丸ノコ
design: 黄色の作業服と革エプロン、遮光面。右手の機械式丸ノコが常時回転。
prompt: Mechanical artificer, tousled chestnut hair, restrained amber anime eyes, brass goggles above forehead, mustard gold tunic under leather smith apron, leather work gloves, dark brown boots

name: 回転
design: 藍色と白の剣士。腰の重ね板と鉢巻、既存の刀。
prompt: Wandering samurai, black layered hair, narrow gray anime eyes, white headband, navy blue and ivory crossed robe, tied obi sash, wrist wraps, gray leg wraps and sandals

name: 爆弾
design: 黒い眼窩の骨兵。肋骨柄と胸に固定した球状爆弾、短い導火線。
prompt: RPG undead skeleton, ivory skull with plain BLACK angular empty eye sockets, triangular nasal hole and simple straight teeth, no eye highlights or smile, bare ribs spine and bones, plain leather bomb harness, no clothes, no human skin or hair

name: カウボーイ
design: 茶革のガンマン。立体のつば広帽とホルスター、右手のリボルバー。
prompt: Frontier fantasy gunslinger, layered brown hair, restrained amber anime eyes, tan leather duster over cream shirt, red cravat, brass buckles, brown boots, no mustache or gritty face

name: 飛行
design: 空色と白の飛行兵。背中の大きな羽毛翼が羽ばたく。
prompt: Winged sky warrior, pale silver hair, calm aqua anime eyes, cream tunic with sky blue panels, silver and gold light armor, wing pattern harness, pale gray boots

name: ボマー
design: 橙の爆破作業員。腰の爆弾と背負い鞄、ゴーグル。
prompt: Fantasy alchemist grenadier, auburn hair, dark orange hooded tunic, leather apron and belt pouches, brass goggles on forehead, brown gloves and boots, no modern military gear

name: タンク
design: 濃紺と銀の重装兵。厚い胸甲、肩甲、面頬、既存の盾。

name: 恵み
design: 白と緑の治療師。フード、腰の薬瓶、背中の救急鞄。
prompt: Forest cleric woman, mint hair under cream hood, calm green anime eyes, white robes with emerald leaf embroidery and green sash, leather book belt, brown shoes

name: 鼓舞
design: 赤と金の鼓舞役。金縁の軍装、背中で揺れる旗と肩章。
prompt: Battle bard commander, auburn hair, focused brown anime eyes, crimson tunic with gold embroidered trim and shoulder braid, cream sash, brown leather boots, medieval outfit

name: テレポート
design: 黒紫の忍び。紫の目と幾何学模様、肩の転移結晶。

name: 痛恨の一撃
design: 赤黒い賭博拳闘士。片腕の巨大な拳甲と鋲。
prompt: Crimson pugilist, spiky russet hair, amber focused anime eyes, sleeveless red martial tunic, tan bare arms, white fist wraps, dark charcoal trousers and iron buckle

name: 汚染
design: 黄緑の防護服。呼吸器と背中の漏出タンク。
prompt: Plague alchemist, olive hood with amber lenses, ochre-green robe, leather respirator covering lower face, acid green potion stains and belt, dark brown gloves and boots, no modern hazmat suit

name: 帯電
design: 青黒い蓄電兵。背中のコイルと銅電極、青い結晶。

name: チェンバー
design: 白シャツ・紺ベスト・金の意匠の狙撃手。眼鏡と細身の長銃。

name: 妖狐
design: 白髪と朱白の狐術師。狐耳、三本の尾が揺れる。

name: 弾幕

name: パワー系

name: 急所

name: ファントム
design: 白灰色の布をかぶった幽霊。黒い眼窩、裂けた裾が揺れる。
prompt: RPG restless wraith, draped ivory linen hood with plain black eye holes, aged pale gray shroud and ragged flowing cloth, no human skin, no smile or cute eyes

name: 散弾
design: 森緑と革の銃士。薬莢帯と短いマント。確認済みの銃と構えを引き継ぐ。
prompt: Fantasy shotgun ranger, layered dark chestnut hair, narrow amber anime eyes, forest green short cloak and cream tunic, brown leather chest harness with red shotgun shells and brass buckles, leather bracers, charcoal trousers and brown boots, no camo or modern soldier helmet
